title: The Sharp Deadline
author: Hazel Eastwick
blurb: Jonah Quintana, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
